subject.title: fix: keep LINE group allowlists scoped [AI]

question: Should LINE group sender authorization require `groupAllowFrom` or per-group `allowFrom`, or continue falling back to explicit configured `allowFrom` while excluding DM pairing-store approvals?
rationale: The PR tightens authorization but removes a current configured fallback, while the earlier merged security fix clearly established only that pairing-store approvals remain DM-scoped; repository evidence cannot safely settle the stronger policy automatically.

options.title: Require group-specific entries
options.body: Approve the stricter boundary, add visible upgrade guidance or diagnostics and live LINE proof, then merge the current direction.

options.title: Keep explicit config fallback
options.body: Retain configured `allowFrom` for group senders, continue excluding pairing-store entries, and test that distinction directly.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until the LINE owner defines the cross-surface allowlist and upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Require group-specific entries
recommendation.body: Approve the stricter boundary, add visible upgrade guidance or diagnostics and live LINE proof, then merge the current direction.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged LINE authorization-boundary synthesis is the closest current-main ownership evidence for this exact security-versus-compatibility decision.
